---
name: Functionality Request
about: Propose a new feature, script, or automation for your repository
title: '[FEAT] '
labels: enhancement
---

## 1. Objective
*What new functionality are you proposing? (e.g., "Add a script to auto-generate RAG evaluation plots from my Qdrant collection")*

## 2. Rationale
*Why is this necessary? How does it improve your specific pipeline/capstone?*

## 3. Implementation Plan
*Draft a high-level plan. What library dependencies are required? What files will be created/modified?*

## 4. Expected Outcome
*What will success look like? How will you verify the new feature works?*
